name: Spotless Studios — Shopify Platinum & Premier Agency Lead Enricher to Sheets

parameters.content:
## Shopify Platinum & Premier Agency Lead Pipeline (v0.2)

1. Set `APIFY_API_TOKEN` in your n8n environment variables.
2. Runs `shopify-partners-scraper` directly against `/tiers/platinum` and `/tiers/premier` with website email & social fallback enabled.
3. Connects to Google Sheets (replace `YOUR_SHEET_ID`) for instant CRM/Clay/Smartlead outreach.

Actor: https://apify.com/spotless_studios/shopify-partners-scraper

parameters.jsCode:
return $input.all().map(({ json }) => ({
  json: {
    businessName: json.businessName || '',
    partnerTier: json.partnerTier || '',
    contactEmail: json.contactEmail || '',
    contactPhone: json.contactPhone || '',
    websiteUrl: json.websiteUrl || '',
    employeeCountRange: json.employeeCountRange || '',
    activeCollaborations: json.activeCollaborations || '',
    acceptingNewClients: json.acceptingNewClients ?? '',
    location: json.location || '',
    country: json.country || '',
    linkedinUrl: (json.socialLinks || []).find((u) => /linkedin\.com/i.test(u)) || '',
    featuredClients: (json.featuredClients || []).map((c) => c.title).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 4).join('; '),
    topServices: (json.services || []).slice(0, 4).join('; '),
    profileUrl: json.url || ''
  }
}));
